questions.prompt: A shared-living preference conflicts with another person’s plan. Make a suitable request and clarify whether it is a preference or an obligation.
questions.context:
In a shared apartment, you prefer housework to be done today; your housemate plans to do it tomorrow. No shared rule specifies today. Explain your practical preference and ask whether today is possible while allowing negotiation.
Familiar meanings available: apartment building; block of flats; household duties; housework; should; may; can.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: My request states the practical need without inventing a rule.
I left room for a relevant response or negotiation.

definition.summary: Your results distinguish checked answers from self-reviewed practice. Unsampled material and unassessed proficiency remain separate.
